patterns.name: Creating Gravity
patterns.summary: How a clear, consistent vision builds a field of attraction that aligns others without force; influence through coherence, not control.

patterns.name: Elastic Leadership
patterns.summary: Staying just far enough ahead to create productive tension without snapping connection; ambition and proximity in dynamic balance.

patterns.name: Vision Anchoring
patterns.summary: Rooting a product or initiative inside a larger, emotionally resonant narrative so that direction feels inevitable rather than imposed.

patterns.name: Alignment Mirage
patterns.summary: The illusion of shared understanding sustained by ambiguous language; coherence dissolves on contact with execution.

patterns.name: Cultural Dialects
patterns.summary: The subtle ways subcultures—engineering, design, operations—encode meaning differently, producing chronic small misunderstandings.

patterns.name: Explanatory Power vs Precision
patterns.summary: Every act of communication trades fidelity for clarity; the craft lies in matching cognitive resolution to audience.

patterns.name: Ontology Leakage
patterns.summary: When internal models and categories seep into the user experience, forcing customers to think like the org instead of being served by it.

patterns.name: Surface Consensus
patterns.summary: When apparent agreement conceals real divergence; surfacing dissonance early prevents brittle coordination.

patterns.name: Conservation of Organizational Cost
patterns.summary: Costs are never eliminated, only shifted between visible and invisible domains; efficiency here creates drag elsewhere.

patterns.name: Perverse Correlation
patterns.summary: Once metrics become targets, they invert their meaning; measurement detaches from reality as optimization takes hold.

patterns.name: Reward Loop Asymmetry
patterns.summary: Short-term incentives generate faster feedback than long-term value, making myopia the rational behavior.

patterns.name: Symbolic Friction
patterns.summary: Small, visible frictions like fees or rituals restore accountability where zero-cost behavior erodes discipline.

patterns.name: Dual Competence
patterns.summary: Mastery in navigating the system versus mastery of the discipline; the two career logics of product management.

patterns.name: Algorithm–Product Gap
patterns.summary: When algorithmic optimization and human experience diverge; a model can be statistically right yet experientially wrong
